Programme 01 · Flagship

Leading Through
AI-Driven Change

Builds confidence and clarity around AI-driven change — reducing fear, improving communication and empowering teams to use AI responsibly. Participants develop a personal action plan during the session and receive a live Action session afterwards to put their learning into practice.

What you'll achieve

  • Reduce fear and resistance to AI-driven change
  • Communicate AI change confidently to your team
  • Empower responsible AI use across your organisation
  • Leave with a personal action plan ready to implement
